content:
There’s a new version of the multi-platform Apple Developer app out today ahead of WWDC 2026. Apple Developer version 11.0 introduces a Liquid Glass design ahead of iOS 27.

Apple’s Developer app includes access to all things WWDC

Apple’s Developer app started life as the WWDC app before taking on the current name. The latest version includes a fresh new app icon:

Last year’s icon is on the left. The new icon is on the right. Bread sticks are out. The original App Store design elements — a pencil, a ruler, and a brush — are in.

The update also adds these changes:

  • Refreshed look with Liquid Glass.
  • List filtering by Unwatched, Bookmarked, and Downloaded, and preferred topics.
  • Improved reliability of image capture during enrollment.
  • Bug fixes and various other enhancements.

The Apple Developer app is available for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro. It also includes an animated iMessage sticker pack.

The new version released today updates the sticker pack for WWDC 2026, including one for Apple’s 50th anniversary.

You can download the newly updated Apple Developer app from the App Store.

WWDC 2026 kicks off on Monday, June 8.
